title: Neural Boundary Integral Solvers for High-Frequency Acoustic Scattering: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Solving high-frequency Helmholtz equations with neural networks suffers from spectral bias. We design a hybrid neural boundary element method combining directional wavepacket representations with boundary operator preconditioning. Our solver resolves acoustic scattering across complex aircraft geometries with 1.8e-4 L2 error in 0.42 seconds. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 5.2x and a verified task accuracy of 98.9% with mean execution latency of 0.42ms.
